title: Bounded native lesson readiness and code-repair procedure

dependency_checks: Resolve private references and verify exact school identity, tested capability, current authority and sole active owner before dependent work.
Acquire the shared browser/source lease including external sessions; a declared concurrency key or missing receipt is not proof that another writer is idle.
Read current authoritative sources and compare relevant revisions immediately before each mutation; stop that mutation on changed, partial or unavailable evidence.
Keep private records and raw evidence outside Git; a configured task, schema validation or open tab never establishes completed execution.
Catalog only: first verify current existing task owner/capability and exact bounded scope; no school-account migration or new schedule follows from this definition.
An independent lesson implementation may own the exact sources. Confirm ownership before any browser/deck action and retain that owner.
Resolve current Agenda, original/current deck IDs and source/manual revisions; inspect all original/current slides including image-only material before claiming full coverage.
Follow installed school-assignment-setup and current lesson-audit/sweep rules; keep restoration, enhancement, codes, native appearance and LMS route checks distinct.
Preserve purposeful repetition, originals, notes, response regions, protected slides and valid codes. Enhance only eligible content before VT/code integration.
Read current Skill 3 and Appendix B before code repair; preserve existing IDs, pair by question identity and prevent duplicate markers outside student writing.
Count verified genuine added Notes boxes separately from baseline and Revision; exclude prompts/templates/decorations/empty placeholders and disclose unknown distributed-baseline provenance.
A parser/deployment repair is separate from a prompt or native code edit; readable matched missing codes alone do not hold grades, except exact current Photosynthesis repair-first scope.
Recheck exact native source and applicable manual revision before writing; verify changed objects, complete rendered coverage, saved links and retained answers afterward.

success_checks: Bounded receipt distinguishes actual native restoration, codes, visual/content coverage, exact Form/folder/LMS links, source revisions and all unverified factors.
Every change preserves original IDs/history and has native saved/rendered readback; current source reader acceptance remains separate.
Writing this contract, saving a task or checking a small page set never completes the separate live lesson-readiness project.
